problem: External GitHub and OSS research was fragmented and could not reliably convert public signals into verified internal capability gains or reusable knowledge.

evidence.ref: Capability Acquisition Loop GitHub Actions SUCCESS
Merged implementation and durable evidence ledger

reusable_pattern: Automate discovery, not trust. Automate signal intake and prioritization, but gate adoption behind primary-source verification, license/security review, isolated proof-of-work, objective evidence, and KEEP/KILL.

audience_value.pain: Teams adopting popular AI/OSS tools without proving whether they actually improve execution, creating tool sprawl and hidden risk.
audience_value.audience: AI agent operators, coding-agent users, automation builders, small teams running multiple AI tools.
audience_value.why_now: Agent and OSS discovery volume is rising faster than most teams can manually verify, making evidence-driven adoption increasingly valuable.

publishing_candidate.reason: Contains implemented workflow, machine-checkable verification, clear failure-prevention logic, and a reusable operating principle rather than a repo list.
